events.title: Oasis's Debut Album Turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which became the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: A Britpop Classic
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe', an album that defined a generation. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Turns 57
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, starting on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love, and Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the legendary Woodstock Festival. What's the one performance you wish you could have witnessed live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, 49 years on. His music and influence are truly everlasting.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' is 57! That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde, born September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are unmistakable.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, born September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Re-release Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was re-released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was re-released in the UK. Its message resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled its revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit cinemas. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Imagine All The People
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th Birthday to comedy legend John Cleese, born October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A Diverse Masterpiece
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58! A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sounds incredible today.
